Context: 13·. Subletting,

- breaches terms and conditions of allotment. - Rule 71.  
Action against subletting of GPRA and Garage and misuse of Garage. When an officer sublets a residence al.lotted to him or any portion thereof or any of the out-houses, garages or stable appurtenant thereto, damages will be charged and the Directorate of Estates shall issue show-cause notice to stop the misuse within 15 days. - Rule 72.
